vendor/fonts/ — self-hosted web fonts for the five demo sites
(reference-a, reference-b, reference-c, reference-d, demo-portfolio)

Downloaded 2026-09-21 with curl from the Google Fonts CSS2 API, using a current
Chrome user agent so the API hands over woff2 rather than ttf. The exact axis and
weight ranges each page already asked for were used, so these are the same files
the browser used to fetch from fonts.gstatic.com at runtime — they now sit here and
are referenced through relative paths (../vendor/fonts/...). Nothing is fetched
from a third party any more.

Only the "latin" and "latin-ext" unicode-range subsets are kept. The pages are in
English; the cyrillic, greek, vietnamese and devanagari subsets Google also offers
were deliberately left out. Each face is declared with its own unicode-range, so
latin-ext is only downloaded if a page actually contains such a character — on
first load of the current pages it is not.

Archivo, Anybody and Instrument Sans are VARIABLE fonts carrying BOTH a weight
(wght) and a width (wdth) axis. That matters: the pages set font-stretch (72%, 84%,
86%, 96%, 108%, 118% ...), which a static instance would silently ignore. Verified
after download by reading the fvar table (see the axis ranges noted per family) and
again in the browser by measuring rendered text width across the width range.

The weight and width RANGES in the @font-face rules on each page are copied verbatim
from the stylesheet Google used to return. They are narrower than what the files can
do (noted below). That is on purpose: it keeps the rendering identical to before.

Licence check: every family was looked up individually in the google/fonts
repository (raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/<dir>/METADATA.pb). All seven
sit in the "ofl/" tree and state license: "OFL". Each downloaded file also carries a
licence URL of its own in its name table, quoted below. The OFL permits self-hosting
and redistribution; it requires the copyright notice and licence to travel with the
files, which is what this file is for. None of these families is reserved-name
restricted in a way that affects use as-is; no font here was renamed or modified.

Full licence text: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/


Archivo — used by reference-b, reference-c, reference-d, demo-portfolio
  designer:    Omnibus-Type
  licence:     SIL Open Font License 1.1  (google/fonts: ofl/archivo, license: "OFL")
  copyright:   Copyright 2020 The Archivo Project Authors
               (https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Archivo)
  licence URL in file:  http://scripts.sil.org/OFL
  source:      https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,400..900
               -> https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/
  retrieved:   2026-09-21
  file axes:   wght 100–900, wdth 62–125   (variable, both axes present)
  files:       archivo-var-latin.woff2        87.9 KB
               archivo-var-latin-ext.woff2    83.8 KB
  note:        one and the same file serves all four sites — Google returns the
               identical woff2 for the 62..125/400..900, 62..125/400..800 and
               90..110/400..700 requests; only the declared range differs.

Big Shoulders Display — used by reference-b
  designer:    Patric King
  licence:     SIL Open Font License 1.1  (google/fonts: ofl/bigshouldersdisplay, license: "OFL")
  copyright:   Copyright 2019 The Big Shoulders Project Authors
               (https://github.com/xotypeco/big_shoulders)
  licence URL in file:  https://scripts.sil.org/OFL
  source:      https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders+Display:wght@600;800;900
               -> https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/bigshouldersdisplay/v24/
  retrieved:   2026-09-21
  file axes:   wght 100–900   (variable, weight only — no width axis)
  files:       big-shoulders-display-var-latin.woff2        34.6 KB
               big-shoulders-display-var-latin-ext.woff2    28.7 KB
  note:        Google declares 600, 800 and 900 as three separate @font-face rules
               pointing at this one variable file. That was kept verbatim, so the
               browser still instances exactly those three weights and downloads once.

               -> https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/bigshouldersstencildisplay/v30/
  retrieved:   2026-09-21
  file axes:   none — this one is a STATIC instance at weight 800, which is all the
               page asked for. No fvar table.
  files:       big-shoulders-stencil-display-var-latin.woff2        14.3 KB
               big-shoulders-stencil-display-var-latin-ext.woff2    13.1 KB
  note:        the "-var-" in the filename is inherited from the naming scheme and is
               inaccurate for this one file; the file itself is static.
